text: dsh-xray-plugin（DSH 插件，适用于 DSH 工具调用界面）：在 DSH 对话中查询插件能力卡片，并汇总多个插件的卡片信息。它向 DSH 注册两个工具：一个按仓库名或 GitHub 地址查询单个插件，另一个汇总一组插件。结果可列出卡片中的能力标记、运行时注入项、环境变量和外联域名等字段，并附卡片链接。适合需要在 DSH 中查阅插件登记信息的用户。运行时从 unstone.github.io 获取卡片 JSON；源码未定义 API 密钥或账号配置。

dsh-xray-plugin (a DSH tool plugin) looks up one plugin capability card or summarizes a list. Its two tools accept a repository name, GitHub URL, or plugin list and return card fields with links. It fetches card JSON from unstone.github.io; no API key or account setting is defined in the source.
想在 DSH 里按仓库名查一个插件的能力卡片。
我有一组插件仓库，想让 DSH 汇总它们卡片里的能力信息。
Look up a plugin card in DSH using its GitHub URL.
dsh-xray-plugin 的功能「查询单个插件卡片」：调用 dsh_xray_check，输入 owner/repo、GitHub URL 或插件名，返回匹配卡片中的说明、标记和卡片链接。
dsh-xray-plugin 的功能「汇总多个插件卡片」：调用 dsh_xray_audit 并传入插件列表，返回已匹配卡片的汇总和逐项链接；没有卡片的条目会单独列出。
dsh-xray-plugin 使用前须知：查询时会从 unstone.github.io 获取插件卡片 JSON，并在进程内缓存六小时；接口请求由源码中的固定地址发起。
dsh-xray-plugin 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 85 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-xray-plugin README · dsh-xray-plugin：**Ask what a dsh plugin can actually do — without leaving your agent.**

English · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Companion plugin for [dsh-xray](https://github.com/unStone/dsh-xray), which statically scans every repository under the `dsh-plugin` topic and publishes a capability card for each.

dsh-xray-plugin README · Why：A dsh plugin is arbitrary code inside your agent runtime. It can rewrite your system prompt, intercept API traffic, spawn subprocesses, read `GITHUB_TOKEN` from your environment, or patch the runtime itself — and nothing in the install path tells you which. dsh has no plugin-level permission declaration, so there is nothing to read even if you look.

This plugin puts the answer where the question comes up: in the agent, at the moment you are deciding.

dsh-xray-plugin README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `dsh_xray_check` | Capability card for one plugin: injected services, hooks, runtime patches, credential-class env reads, install-time scripts — each with `file:line` evidence. |
| `dsh_xray_audit` | Summary across several plugins, e.g. the ones you have installed: how many carry powerful capability, which patch the runtime, which read credentials. |

Ask your agent naturally:

> Is `tt-a1i/archify` safe to install?

> Audit the plugins I have installed.

dsh-xray-plugin README · Capability levels：**C0** no notable surface · **C1** ordinary · **C2** one powerful capability or sensitive behaviour · **C3** both.

Levels measure **capability surface and transparency, not maliciousness**. A C3 plugin can be entirely legitimate — a desktop shell genuinely needs subprocesses, and several of the highest-scoring projects in the ecosystem are among its best-engineered. The distinction that matters is between a plugin that *needs* strong capability and one that *has* it without anyone noticing.

dsh-xray-plugin README · Capability levels：This is not malware detection. Static analysis cannot establish intent, and a determined bad actor evades it easily. The gap it addresses is that nobody knows what ordinary plugins do.

dsh-xray-plugin README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/unStone/dsh-xray-plugin/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-xray-plugin-0.1.0.tgz
```

The release carries a prebuilt bundle, so the install skips pnpm's build-script
approval step. Installing from source (`dsh plugin add unStone/dsh-xray-plugin`)
also works, but pnpm will ask you to allowlist the build first.

dsh-xray-plugin README · Data：Cards are fetched from [`data.json`](https://unstone.github.io/dsh-xray/data.json), refreshed by a daily scan of the whole ecosystem, and cached for six hours. No telemetry: the plugin sends nothing about you or your setup — it fetches a static file and reads it locally.

dsh-xray-plugin README · Data：Browse the same data on the web: [registry](https://unstone.github.io/dsh-xray/registry.html) · [levels explained](https://unstone.github.io/dsh-xray/levels.html) · [ecosystem report](https://unstone.github.io/dsh-xray/report.html)

dsh-xray-plugin README · False positives：Every flag cites the file and line it came from, so disputes are checkable. [Open an issue](https://github.com/unStone/dsh-xray/issues) — rules are fixed in public and the next daily scan picks up the correction.

dsh-xray-plugin README · Build：```sh
npm install
npm run build
```
